  substrings "Customer" and "Grand Total" in its text (commonly the
  "Last Orders" widget). If your admin panel uses another language or
  custom headers, adapt the table-detection heuristic in the function to
  match those translated header substrings.

Behavior / what this does (general procedure):
- Always begins by navigating to the relative dashboard URL so the
  function can be invoked from any prior page state.
- Proactively checks presence using `await locator.count()` before any
  indexed access (`.nth()`) to avoid Playwright indexing/stale-node
  errors. There is no global try/except that hides failures; only narrow
  localized catches are used for operations that may fail transiently
  (evaluating option labels, selecting an option, or reading inner_text
  of a node that may detach during re-render).
- If a combobox with accessible name "Choose Store View:" exists, the
  function will attempt to select the requested `store_view`. It first
  attempts an exact visible-label selection; if that exact label isn't
  present it collects visible option labels from the <select> element
  and performs a case-insensitive substring match to find a selectable
  label. The code checks counts before reading options.
- If a helper named `generate_sales_summary_for_date_range` exists in
  globals(), the function will call it to apply `date_range`. The code
  safely detects whether the helper is an async function or returns an
  awaitable and awaits it accordingly. If the helper is absent or fails
  the function uses conservative waits to allow widgets to stabilize.
- Scans `page.get_by_role('table')` and selects the first table whose
  inner text contains both the substrings "Customer" and "Grand Total".
  Counts are re-checked inside loops to avoid stale-index issues.
- Extracts up to `n` non-header rows. For each row it checks the cell
  count using `await cells.count()` before reading `.nth()` cells. Many
  Magento dashboard cells render a non-breaking space (NBSP, ' ')
  when empty; this function strips NBSP characters so empty cells become
